CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real MOVE-stat gameplay effect: new stat_effects_mod.prn ports the construct's own progression_apply_bonuses formula (boost = 1.0 + 0.035*rank) as I32 permille, wired into apps/server's real movement tick. Verified live at exactly 1.0350x measured speed ratio, matching the real construct formula precisely. Other 4 stats deliberately deferred (no health/shield/cooldown systems exist yet). (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
